body.name: Deterministic arm quotas
body.construction: Set \(e_1(t)=ct^{-\alpha}\), \(e_0(t)=\varepsilon\), \(Q_a(s)=\sum_{t\leq s}e_a(t)\), and \(K_a(s)=\max\{2,\lfloor Q_a(s)-\sqrt{8Q_a(s)\log T}\rfloor\}\); set \(J_a=K_a(k_T)\) and \(E_T=\bigcap_{a\in\mathcal A}\{N_a(n_T)\geq K_a(n_T),\ N_a(k_T)\geq J_a\}\).
